final_prompts.A: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: revised portrait Shorts cover for Nuviko History, concept A. Create an ultra-realistic 14th-century English field where one worker stands prominently with a plain farm tool, a wide field needing labour behind him, and a landowner waiting far back. The restrained drawn Nuviko traveler observes from the side, matching the provided identity reference (adult man, wavy brown hair graying at temples, short graying beard, ochre jacket, light henley, dark backpack). Rich but subdued cinematic historic detail. Portrait 9:16. Critical crop rule: the central 2:3 vertical crop removes about 8% of the image at both top and bottom, so place the ENTIRE text block well below the top edge, starting around 19% of full-image height and ending by 39%; keep the main faces inside the crop too. Leave a visibly safe margin above the text. Text verbatim: "THEY NEEDED HIM". Render these exact three uppercase words, large bold cream serif with slight aged texture and dark outline/shadow, high contrast, no other lettering. Centered upper-middle, not touching any edge. The text must be fully visible in the central 2:3 crop and legible at a 180x270 preview. Story means labour demand created bargaining room for some people; don’t show a signed deal or imply every worker gained freedom. No gore, chains, modern objects, watermark, logos or pseudo-text.
final_prompts.B: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: vertical YouTube Shorts cover for Nuviko History. Primary request: create concept B, a thumbnail about England's attempt to hold down wages after the Black Death. Reference image: use the supplied traveler PNG only as the identity and restrained illustrated-style reference for the recurring Nuviko traveler; do not copy its ancient/Roman setting. Scene: realistic medieval English hall, foreground official's hands presenting a plain uninscribed parchment on a table toward a working man in simple 14th-century clothing; their opposing positions make the conflict readable. Place the same subdued drawn traveler from the reference in the midground observing quietly, wearing his ochre jacket, light henley, dark backpack; he must not dominate the historical scene. Style: ultra-realistic historical world with one gently hand-drawn traveler, natural proportions, subdued earthy light, fine cinematic detail. Composition/framing: portrait 9:16; keep all important faces and the full text inside the central 2:3 safe crop; large clean upper-center space for a short hook; strong readable hierarchy at phone size. Text (verbatim): "PAY BY LAW?" Render exactly these four words/characters, capitalized, with a clear question mark; large elegant bold cream serif lettering with subtle aged-paper grain and dark edge contrast, no other text. Constraints: historically plausible generic hall and clothing; parchment blank, no legible invented writing; compelling but restrained; no plague victims, no gore, no chains, no modern objects, no watermark, no logos, no fake typography beyond the exact quoted phrase.
final_prompts.C_base: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: revised portrait YouTube Shorts cover for Nuviko History, concept C. Story: survival after the Black Death did not automatically remove poverty or dependence. Show one medieval English worker standing beside a modest timber cottage; distant fields and manor suggest continued work and hierarchy. The recurring subdued hand-drawn Nuviko traveler from the provided reference observes thoughtfully in the midground, with same face, wavy brown hair graying at temples, short graying beard, ochre jacket, light henley and dark backpack. Realistic, grounded, cinematic 14th-century English world. Portrait 9:16. Central 2:3 crop is important: place all letters and faces well within the crop. Do not place any lettering in the topmost 17% of the image; put the full text block around 20%-43% height, with generous margin above and below. Text verbatim, exactly: "SURVIVAL ≠ FREEDOM". Use three clear centered lines: SURVIVAL / ≠ / FREEDOM, cream bold serif with subtle aged texture and strong dark contrast; exact words and correct not-equal symbol, no other text. Check visually legible in a 180x270 preview. Keep the worker expressive but dignified; no chains, broken shackles or triumphant liberation. No gore, modern objects, watermark, logos or pseudo-writing.
final_prompts.C_outpaint: Use case: precise-object-edit / outpaint. Asset type: final vertical 9:16 YouTube Shorts cover.
